raw.title: Chief of Staff to the CTO - Engineering
raw.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 
 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.

You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.

 

Team and Context

Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter.

You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.

Key missions

Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives

  • Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown

  • Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution

  • Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership

Planning & Performance tracking

  • Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership

  • Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable

  • Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction)

Decision-making and leadership cadence

  • Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land

  • Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next

  • Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team

Communication

  • Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates

Who you’ll work with?

  • CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers)

  • Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives)

  • Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People)

Who we’re looking for

Must-have

  • An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum)

  • Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers

  • 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering

  • A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders

  • Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on

  • Fluency in English

Nice-to-have

  • A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent

  • Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company

What you can expect?

Within one month

  • You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices

  • You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment

  • You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone

Within 3-6 months

  • You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target

  • The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions

  • You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them

  • You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Quentin - CTO (45 mins)

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Scale up Healthtech
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. Elle compte aujourd’hui 8 Sales Account Executives qui travaillent sur l’ensemble du territoire. Les Sales concentrent aujourd’hui leur temps sur les plus grands établissements et groupements hospitaliers. À côté, il existe un vivier d’environ 800 structures de santé de plus petite taille. Leur potentiel est réel, mais le CRM est encore peu qualifié et les bons interlocuteurs restent souvent à identifier. Nous créons donc notre premier poste de SDR Public. Ton rôle sera de construire ce périmètre : mieux connaître ces structures, trouver les personnes à contacter, qualifier les opportunités et transmettre aux Sales des rendez-vous réellement exploitables. Tu travailleras principalement sur nos offres Lifen Documents et Curecall by Lifen. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Cartographier et prioriser un portefeuille d’environ 800 petites structures de santé, en partant d’une base CRM encore largement à enrichir. Identifier les bons interlocuteurs au sein de ces établissements, en mobilisant les informations disponibles sur Internet, LinkedIn, le téléphone et les autres canaux de prospection. Entrer en contact avec les prospects, comprendre leur contexte et qualifier les opportunités avant de proposer un échange avec un ou une Sales Account Executive. Générer des rendez-vous qualifiés pour l’équipe Sales, en transmettant les informations utiles pour permettre une prise de relais efficace. Mettre à jour le CRM avec rigueur : contacts, informations sur les structures, niveau de maturité des opportunités et prochaines étapes. Faire progresser les méthodes de prospection sur ce nouveau périmètre : messages, séquences, critères de qualification et priorisation des comptes. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une première expérience commerciale (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client. Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié. La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM. Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé. Nice-to-have Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé. Une première expérience dans un environnement startup ou scale-up. La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection. Soft skills Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Face à une base peu qualifiée, tu sais chercher, trier l’information et décider par où commencer, sans te disperser. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity . Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées. Bienveillance . Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien. Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents. 👥 Process de recrutement Le process est volontairement court et se déroulera principalement en visio. TAM Screening avec l’équipe recrutement - Environ 30 minutes. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ta motivation pour le poste et d’évaluer les fondamentaux attendus : communication, énergie, organisation et posture commerciale. Case study avec l’équipe Sales - Un entretien en visio d’1h comprenant la restitution de trois exercices : deux préparés à l’avance et un exercice réalisé en direct. Le cas sera envoyé environ deux jours avant l’échange et demandera environ 1h30 à 2h de préparation. Il permettra d’évaluer ta capacité à qualifier un compte, à prioriser, à structurer une approche de prospection et à communiquer avec clarté. Final Interview - Un entretien avec un Manager de l’équipe Sales pour valider l’alignement culturel. Nous nous engageons à te donner de la visibilité tout au long du process et à revenir vers toi sous 72h après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord. Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:   - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently   Ready to help shape the future of work? You will manage engineering managers and staff engineers to position Malt as the global system of record for enterprise freelance workforces. Embed compliance by design across all markets, building worker classification safeguards, secure vaults, and custom contract capabilities directly into the product. Act as the executive engineering voice in client face-offs, joining strategic sales deals, security reviews, and C-level conversations with CTOs, CIOs, and Procurement leaders. You have a product and commercial acumen in terms of customer and business outcomes. You can make and explain trade-offs between enterprise-specific demands and platform leverage. Track record in driving engineering execution and building high-trust, cohesive teams across distributed hubs.  English on a native level, with the confidence and technical stature to lead high-level discourse in front of enterprise decision-makers (CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, Procurement heads) and win complex RFPs across Enterprise and Public Sector accounts. title: Staff Windows Low Level C++ Engineer - Endpoint security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p><span data-sheets-root="1">As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.</span></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our <strong>Endpoint Protection product</strong>, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (<strong>We're currently growing multiple teams</strong> and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).</p> <p>The <strong>Platform group</strong> teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:</p> <ul> <li>Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,</li> <li>usermode security &amp; agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer &amp; interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance &amp; stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.</li> </ul> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the<a href="https://s1.ai/endpoint" target="_blank"> EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne</a> - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&amp;ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.</span></p> <h3><strong>What will you do?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode &amp; kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.</li> <li>You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals &amp; Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection &amp; Response eco-system.</li> <li>Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance &amp; optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).</li> <li>Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise &amp; government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).</li> <li>You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.</li> <li><strong>Working setup:</strong> Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What skills &amp; knowledge should you bring?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)</li> <li>Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design &amp; internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools</li> <li>Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment</li> <li>Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking</li> <li>Attention to detail and high coding standards</li> <li>An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why SentinelOne?</strong></h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical and insurance benefits</li> <li>Disability insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Work-from-home allowance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: En tant que Bureau d’études Fluides dans le domaine du bâtiment durable et intelligent, DEERNS recherche pour son bureau parisien un(e) Ingénieur CVC senior ou confirmé(e). Vous serez responsable de la conception CVC/Plomberie des projets étant le garant de la qualité des études produites et des documents techniques émis. Vous êtes le leader de la discipline « CVC/Plomberie » et avez à votre charge l’encadrement d’ingénieurs moins expérimentés. Vous êtes en contact régulier avec le client pour définir les exigences de conception lors du démarrage du projet, développez les concepts CVC, dirigez une équipe d'ingénieurs et de spécialistes. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. Come join us.</p></div><h4><strong>Please submit your CV in English!</strong></h4> <h4><strong>The opportunity:</strong></h4> <p>The role of the Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.</p> <p>This role is designed to facilitate the movement of shipments while discovering and driving efficiencies that build and improve operations as part of our Global team. You will be responsible for ensuring that all customer shipments are executed according to plan, on time and within budget. As the person who manages movement in your region with laser focus, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry</li> </ul> <p><strong>What else:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will work in a beautiful office in the city center of Paris with modern office equipment and a first class connection to the public transport system of Paris.</li> <li>You will work in a fast growing and changing environment with a high motivated team, which is always open to hear your ideas</li> <li>We invest in your personal and professional development by offering you internal and external trainings</li> <li>During regular team events you can have a lot of fun with your teammates and connect with them aside from your working day</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a&nbsp; thriving multinational environment&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>25 working days</strong> working days of paid annual leave per complete year of service</li> <li>The employee shall be affiliated to the French social security system (Sécurité sociale) Employer and employee contributions shall be calculated and deducted in accordance with statutory rates.</li> <li>50% reimbursement of the cost of the public transportation subscription(s) used for travel between your place of residence and the workplace.&nbsp;</li> <li>Employer's collective supplementary health insurance scheme (mutuelle d'entreprise) as required by law. Flexport shall contribute at least 50% of the premium for the base coverage.</li> <li><strong>Lunches compensation</strong>: EUR 12 for every day worked in the office</li> <li><strong>Parental leave benefit:</strong> Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.&nbsp;</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. We offer a&nbsp;hybrid work arrangement, with Monday, Tuesday and Thursday in-office, and Wednesday&nbsp;and Friday as remote. Tuesday is the office company-sponsored meal.<br><br></p> <h4><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>End-to-End French Accounting Ownership:</strong> Own the complete month-end close process for the French entity and maintain local accounting books in close collaboration with the global accounting team.</li> <li><strong>Statutory Audit &amp; Tax Compliance:</strong> Lead the annual French Statutory Audit, manage tax/VAT filings, and coordinate the annual CIR (Crédit d'Impôt Recherche) preparation with Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Financial Alignment:</strong> Partner with the Global Controller on the annual US GAAP audit, internal controls, and special international accounting projects.</li> <li><strong>Revenue Recognition &amp; B2B Operations:</strong> Manage US GAAP ASC 606 revenue recognition, support payment automation, and oversee B2B invoicing, AR collections, and local compliance.</li> <li><strong>Operational &amp; Payroll Oversight:</strong> Monitor third-party payroll JEs and accruals, process vendor bills and credit cards with proper GL coding, manage T&amp;E compliance, and perform balance sheet reconciliations (bank, fixed assets, and balance sheet).</li> <li><strong>Project Leadership &amp; System Compliance:</strong> Optimize French accounting systems (Pennylane ERP) and lead project management for the 2027 French e-invoicing compliance initiatives across AP and AR.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatic Decision-Making:</strong> Navigate ambiguity to make sound accounting decisions with incomplete data in a fast-paced environment, balancing technical precision with operational flexibility.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Leadership:</strong> Foster an open, supportive environment by sharing knowledge, managing workload to hit tight deadlines, and collaborating across global and local teams.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder &amp; Vendor Management:</strong> Build strong professional relationships with external third parties, including payroll vendors, audit firms, and statutory partners.</li> <li><strong>Process Improvement:</strong> Create and regularly update internal process documentation to ensure financial data integrity.</li> <li><strong>AI &amp; Workflow Automation:</strong> Modernize French accounting operations by adopting AI-assisted tools and automated workflows to accelerate reconciliations, month-end close, AR/AP, and accruals.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Requirements:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>7+ years of relevant accounting and tax experience</li> <li>Strong French Statutory accounting knowledge</li> <li>GAAP - ASC 606 Revenue Recognition knowledge (particularly within subscription or multi-channel B2B payment models)</li> <li>Fluency in French and English (spoken and written)</li> <li>Experience with Pennylane and NetSuite or other large ERP systems (or similar modern financial platforms)</li> <li>Strong Excel skills (for complex data analysis, reconciliations, and financial modeling)</li> <li>Attention to detail and accuracy, structured and autonomous working style</li> <li>Pragmatic business judgment and ability to balance technical accounting precision with operational speed, applying a sharp sense of materiality to navigate ambiguity and solve complex issues in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Genuine passion for sharing knowledge and fostering an open, supportive team environment, focusing on coaching, empowering, and elevating colleagues&nbsp;</li> <li>Exceptional communication and diplomacy skills to build seamless, high-trust relationships across international internal teams and key external partners (auditors, payroll vendors, tax authorities).</li> <li>Proven ability to take full accountability for local financial outcomes, bringing a proactive, solution-oriented approach to organizing priorities, resolving operational challenges, and consistently delivering under tight deadlines.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>We Are Also Looking For:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>US GAAP accounting knowledge&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong enthusiasm for AI and digital transformation, with a drive to leverage modern AI tools and workflow automation to streamline reconciliations, close processes, and financial reporting.</li> <li>Direct hands-on experience coordinating annual French R&amp;D tax credit (CIR) preparations Dashlane</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Mentorship program - select your mentor from our internal pool and continue your learning path!</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" title: Post-Doctorant·e en Intelligence artificielle informée par la physique pour la modélisation hydrogéologique - CDD 13 mois - IMT Mines Alès
description: Venez rejoindre l'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM. Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PREV’IA qui s’intéresse à la connaissance et à la prévision des ressources en eaux de la nappe plioquaternaire de la plaine de Roussillon, et de la source du Lez qui alimente Montpellier en eau potable. Votre travail s’inscrira dans la continuité d’une thèse en cours au sein de l’UMR HSM (équipe HYTAKE), portant sur la durabilité de la ressource en eau karstique (aquifère du Lez) alimentant une métropole méditerranéenne (Montpellier) en contexte de changement climatique.   Votre mission : Utiliser les concepts émergeants dans les approches de « Physics Informed Machine Learning » (PIML) pour évaluer les intérêts d’une synergie en modélisation hydrogéologique : (1) à base conceptuelle d’une part et (2) à base de réseaux de neurones informés, ou complémentés, par la physique. L’approche PIML (Physics Informed Machine Learning) est développée, avec deux courants : (i) les Physics Informed Architecture (PIA) : intégration de connaissances physiques dans l’architecture du modèle (couches cachées) ; et (ii) les Physics Informed Loss Function (PILF) : combinaison de modélisations physiques (équations différentielles) et boîte noire, fusionnées dans la fonction de coût (terme de régularisation). Les deux méthodes pourront être explorées. Les modèles proposés pourront être utilisés pour déterminer l’évolution de certaines grandeurs hydrologiques en réponse au changement climatique. L’IMT Mines Alès s’engage à mettre en place les aménagements nécessaires pour les personnes en situation de handicap, afin de garantir un environnement de travail inclusif et accessible.  Salaire : 35 542 € brut annuel. description: IMT Atlantique , reconnue internationalement pour la qualité de sa recherche, est une école d’ingénieurs de premier plan sous la tutelle du ministère de l'industrie et du numérique, classée dans les trois principaux classements internationaux (THE, SHANGHAI, QS).   Le poste est ouvert sur le campus de Rennes au sein du département SRCD (Systèmes Réseaux, Cybersécurité et Droit du numérique) . Le département SRCD est composé de 24 enseignant.e.s-chercheurs.euses permanent.e.s, plus de 10 post-doctorant.e.s et ingénieur.e.s contractuel.le.s, et 30 doctorant.e.s. Ses domaines d'activité recouvrent tous les aspects de l'enseignement et de la recherche en systèmes et réseaux au sens large, en cybersécurité, et en droit et économie des activités numériques. Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche, la personne recrutée rejoindra l’équipe SOTERN (Self Protecting the Future Internet) du département D2 du laboratoire IRISA (UMR CNRS 6074), l'un des plus grands laboratoires de recherche français (+ de 850 personnes) dans le domaine de l'informatique et des nouvelles technologies de l'information. Enjeux et profil attendu sur le thématique de recherche   Deux enjeux majeurs présentent actuellement un impact conséquent sur la recherche et l’innovation en Cybersécurité. D’un côté, l’intelligence artificielle par ses développements récents et les attendus pour les années à venir décuple les possibilités offertes aux attaquants pour mettre en œuvre de nouvelles attaques, tout autant qu’aux structures défensives (type SOC par exemple) pour détecter, corréler et contrer des incidents de sécurité. D’un autre côté, les cibles des attaques évoluent et les architectures déployées dans les réseaux opérationnels (systèmes industriels, réseaux intra-véhiculaires, avionique, opérateurs d’importance vitale) nécessitent de nouveaux moyens de détection et protection face à une menace grandissante. Le profil recherché pour ce poste s’inscrit ainsi dans la thématique de la sécurité des réseaux au sens large. Il sera plus spécifiquement recherché soit une expertise relative aux architectures, protocoles et algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour la sécurité des réseaux ou de l’IA (apprentissage fédéré, sécurité des architectures d’IA type Model Context Protocol (MCP), etc.), soit une expertise sur la sécurité des réseaux opérationnels (OT) quel qu’en soit le cadre applicatif.     Enjeux et profil attendu en enseignement   Positionnée sur 3 campus attractifs, IMT Atlantique affiche une forte dynamique internationale tout en restant à taille humaine. Dans ces différents cursus BAC+5 (formations d’ingénieurs et de masters-DNM), les étudiants sont confrontés, via des approches pédagogiques variées, à des situations-problèmes concrets. L’école a ainsi pour ambition de former de jeunes professionnels à fort potentiel, capables de mobiliser un large spectre de compétences en situation réelle, dans des environnements (production, recherche, création d’activité, etc.) et des domaines socio-économiques variés.   Impliqué tant en tronc commun que dans les parcours électifs, la personne recrutée contribuera aussi bien dans sa spécialité Cybersécurité que dans des activités transverses, interdisciplinaires ou en lien avec des entreprises : tutorat de projets / stages, soutenances, accompagnement, etc. La personne recrutée sera encouragée à contribuer, dans un esprit de collaboration, à l’évolution cohérente des programmes d’études, en proposant de nouveaux projets, programmes et méthodologies pédagogiques, particulièrement inspirés et soutenus par les exigences et les partenariats industriels. https://www.imt-atlantique.fr/fr/formation   En cohérence avec le profil de la personne candidate, il sera demandé de prendre en main les thématiques d’enseignement parmi les suivantes : IA et Cybersécurité (IA offensive, IA pour la protection des infrastructures, sécurité de l’IA), Sécurité des systèmes industriels, participation puis prise de responsabilité de l’organisation du CTF Hack’lantique, et plus largement une participation aux différents enseignements en Cybersécurité.   Responsabilité collective et implication dans le développement économique En effet une attention particulière sera portée sur la capacité du candidat à s’impliquer dans la vie collective de l’école : contribuer, ou piloter des projets transverses (par exemple sur la transition écologique, prendre des responsabilités (programmes de formation, projets de recherche, équipes pédagogiques ou de recherche) ou participer à des instances : comité de l’enseignement, conseil d’école, comité social d’administration. En outre dans un environnement de relations privilégiées avec de grands partenaires industriels nationaux et internationaux, ainsi qu’un réseau dense de PME, Start up, l’enseignant chercheur recruté contribuera au rayonnement de l’école et au développement économique, notamment au travers de la valorisation de ses travaux par le dépôt de brevet ou le transfert de technologies. D’un côté, l’intelligence artificielle par ses développements récents et les attendus pour les années à venir décuple les possibilités offertes aux attaquants pour mettre en œuvre de nouvelles attaques, tout autant qu’aux structures défensives (type SOC par exemple) pour détecter, corréler et contrer des incidents de sécurité. D’un autre côté, les cibles des attaques évoluent et les architectures déployées dans les réseaux opérationnels (systèmes industriels, réseaux intra-véhiculaires, avionique, opérateurs d’importance vitale) nécessitent de nouveaux moyens de détection et protection face à une menace grandissante.

Le profil recherché pour ce poste s’inscrit ainsi dans la thématique de la sécurité des réseaux au sens large. Il sera plus spécifiquement recherché soit une expertise relative aux architectures, protocoles et algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour la sécurité des réseaux ou de l’IA (apprentissage fédéré, sécurité des architectures d’IA type Model Context Protocol (MCP), etc.), soit une expertise sur la sécurité des réseaux opérationnels (OT) quel qu’en soit le cadre applicatif.  

 

Enjeux et profil attendu en enseignement

 

Positionnée sur 3 campus attractifs, IMT Atlantique affiche une forte dynamique internationale tout en restant à taille humaine. Dans ces différents cursus BAC+5 (formations d’ingénieurs et de masters-DNM), les étudiants sont confrontés, via des approches pédagogiques variées, à des situations-problèmes concrets. L’école a ainsi pour ambition de former de jeunes professionnels à fort potentiel, capables de mobiliser un large spectre de compétences en situation réelle, dans des environnements (production, recherche, création d’activité, etc.) et des domaines socio-économiques variés.

 

Impliqué tant en tronc commun que dans les parcours électifs, la personne recrutée contribuera aussi bien dans sa spécialité Cybersécurité que dans des activités transverses, interdisciplinaires ou en lien avec des entreprises : tutorat de projets / stages, soutenances, accompagnement, etc. La personne recrutée sera encouragée à contribuer, dans un esprit de collaboration, à l’évolution cohérente des programmes d’études, en proposant de nouveaux projets, programmes et méthodologies pédagogiques, particulièrement inspirés et soutenus par les exigences et les partenariats industriels. https://www.imt-atlantique.fr/fr/formation

 

En cohérence avec le profil de la personne candidate, il sera demandé de prendre en main les thématiques d’enseignement parmi les suivantes : IA et Cybersécurité (IA offensive, IA pour la protection des infrastructures, sécurité de l’IA), Sécurité des systèmes industriels, participation puis prise de responsabilité de l’organisation du CTF Hack’lantique, et plus largement une participation aux différents enseignements en Cybersécurité.

 

Responsabilité collective et implication dans le développement économique

En effet une attention particulière sera portée sur la capacité du candidat à s’impliquer dans la vie collective de l’école : contribuer, ou piloter des projets transverses (par exemple sur la transition écologique, prendre des responsabilités (programmes de formation, projets de recherche, équipes pédagogiques ou de recherche) ou participer à des instances : comité de l’enseignement, conseil d’école, comité social d’administration.

En outre dans un environnement de relations privilégiées avec de grands partenaires industriels nationaux et internationaux, ainsi qu’un réseau dense de PME, Start up, l’enseignant chercheur recruté contribuera au rayonnement de l’école et au développement économique, notamment au travers de la valorisation de ses travaux par le dépôt de brevet ou le transfert de technologies. Avec 257 enseignants-chercheurs permanents, 2450 étudiants dont 399 doctorants, IMT Atlantique produit chaque année 655 publications et lève 28.3M€ de fonds de recherche.

description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l’industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche place IMT Mines Albi comme une école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT : l’industrie du futur responsable ; l’énergie, l’économie circulaire et la société ; l’ingénierie, la santé et le bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s’est dotée en 2023, pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en sept grandes actions, répondant aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT auquel elle appartient.   IMT Mines Albi représente : 985 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation ; 300 personnels ; un budget consolidé de 32 M€ ; trois centres de formation et de recherche : Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A), RAPSODEE et Centre Génie Industriel.     Le Centre Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A) est un centre de formation et de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi. Il rassemble 70 personnes, dont 20 enseignants-chercheurs. Au titre de la formation, il est un acteur de la formation ingénieur généraliste d’IMT Mines Albi, sous statut étudiant ou apprenti, et porte l’option « Matériaux et procédés avancés pour les transports de demain ».   Au titre de la recherche, il est partie intégrante de l’ Institut Clément Ader (ICA – UMR CNRS 5312) , laboratoire rassemblant 250 personnes et développant des thématiques scientifiques axées sur l’ingénierie et la mécanique des matériaux, notamment dans le domaine de l’aéronautique. Ses cinq établissements de tutelle sont l’INSA de Toulouse, l’ISAE-SUPAERO, l’Université Paul Sabatier, IMT Mines Albi et le CNRS.   Site Internet de l’ICA : https://ica.cnrs.fr/   L’ICA traite des études sur les structures, les systèmes et les processus mécaniques. Ses secteurs d’activité sont les industries mécaniques, avec un accent particulier sur l’aérospatiale, l’espace, le transport et l’énergie. Le centre Institut Clément Ader Albi contribue aux quatre groupes de recherche de l’ICA : Matériaux et Structures Composites ; Surfaces, Usinage, Matériaux, Outillages ; Métrologie, Identification, Contrôle, Surveillance ; Modélisation des Systèmes et Microsystèmes Mécaniques.   Le champ d’action d’ICA-A est d’optimiser les outillages ou les procédés de mise en forme des matériaux (métaux, composites, polymères, verres, etc.) ainsi que d’étudier les relations entre microstructure, procédé et comportement, en particulier pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique et du spatial. ICA-A est une Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR) depuis 2021.   DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : De manière générale, la personne recrutée participera aux projets pédagogiques de l’école, aux missions de formation, aux activités de recherche et de transfert de technologies, au montage et au suivi des activités contractuelles ainsi qu’aux collaborations nationales et internationales. Elle contribuera activement au développement de ces activités et pourra être amenée à exercer des responsabilités administratives et d’encadrement.   La personne recrutée aura notamment vocation à assurer :   des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ; et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : directeur de centre, directeur de centre adjoint, responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ; et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique ; et/ou des responsabilités transverses, comme par exemple : responsable de processus ou sous-processus, responsable thématique international.   Activités de formation Dans le programme de formation du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée participera aux activités pédagogiques et d’enseignement d’IMT Mines Albi.  Dans ce cadre, elle sera amenée à : contribuer à l’évolution des programmes pédagogiques et assurer des enseignements dans les domaines de l’analyse de données et de l’intelligence artificielle appliquées à l’écoconception, au développement de nouveaux matériaux, à leur mise en forme, ainsi qu’à l’étude de leurs mécanismes de dégradation et à la prévision de la durée de vie des pièces ; accompagner et organiser les missions de formation de l’École sous leurs diverses formes : formation initiale ou continue, sous statut étudiant ou salarié, et formations débouchant sur des diplômes de Mastère ou de Master ; participer au montage ou au pilotage de nouvelles formations (Mastère ou Master), prendre la responsabilité d’une ou plusieurs unités d’enseignement, s’impliquer dans l’organisation et le suivi de projets étudiants, ainsi que dans l’élaboration et l’exploitation de MOOC ; encadrer des projets avec mises en situation, des stages et des travaux de fin d’études.   Activités de recherche   Dans le programme de recherche du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée : proposera une démarche scientifique pour le développement de méthodes innovantes d’exploitation et d’analyse de données et d’utilisation de l’IA, capables de répondre aux exigences d’un dialogue essais/calcul multi-échelles. sera rattachée à un des groupes de recherche du laboratoire ICA (UMR 5312) devra démontrer sa capacité à développer une activité contractuelle avec les entreprises et à participer au montage de chaires d’enseignement et de recherche en relation avec les entreprises ; contribuera au rayonnement scientifique d’IMT Mines Albi et du laboratoire ICA par une implication active dans l’encadrement de thèses et de post-doctorants, par une production scientifique significative, par la diffusion de l’information scientifique lors de conférences et par l’organisation de manifestations scientifiques ; sera amenée à monter des projets collaboratifs en lien avec les autres centres de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi : RAPSODEE et CGI.     Activités de valorisation et de développement économique Dans le programme de valorisation et de développement économique du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée devra : renforcer le développement économique local et régional par l’accompagnement d’entités en incubation ou en prospection d’incubation au sein d’IMT Mines Albi ; et/ou soutenir les initiatives ponctuelles en répondant aux demandes d’accompagnement (thèses CIFRE, contrats directs) formulées par les entreprises, en particulier les TPE et PME, dans son domaine d’expertise ; et/ou accompagner la dynamique industrielle en s’impliquant dans la mise en place et le pilotage de chaires industrielles ou de laboratoires communs permettant d’optimiser le transfert technologique et méthodologique à destination des acteurs locaux, régionaux ou nationaux.   Évolution des responsabilités À moyen terme, la personne recrutée pourra se voir proposer : des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ; et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ; et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique.     PROFIL RECHERCHE : La personne candidate devra justifier d’une expérience d’au moins huit ans en recherche dans la spécialité Data/IA appliquée aux matériaux et procédés .   Une qualification aux fonctions de professeur en 60e section du CNU est fortement souhaitée.   En outre, la personne candidate devra :   présenter une expertise scientifique dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : jumeaux numériques, dynamique des systèmes, machine learning, deep learning, réseaux de neurones, deep optimisation ; justifier d’expériences dans la conception et le pilotage de programmes pédagogiques ; faire preuve d’une forte capacité et d’un goût prononcé pour l’animation d’une équipe de recherche ; posséder de réelles qualités relationnelles, ainsi qu’un sens développé des relations humaines et des valeurs collectives ; présenter une production scientifique cohérente avec les standards nationaux et internationaux et une expérience significative de l’encadrement doctoral.   AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?  Un cadre de travail agréable sur un campus de 22 hectares ; Date limite de candidature : 1er novembre 2026. Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 1er janvier 2027.   Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap.   Contacts : Sur le contenu du poste : Mme Anaïs BARASINSKI – Directrice de Centre   Sur les aspects administratifs/RH : Mme Marie GILLET – Responsable Recrutement et Développement des Compétences   Protection des données Dans le cadre du règlement général sur la protection des données, les candidates et candidats sont informés que les données les concernant seront conservées par l’administration pendant une durée maximale de deux ans, sauf demande contraire de leur part précisée dans la lettre de motivation. description: <p>Datadog’s Chaos Engineering team builds systems that surface reliability weaknesses before they become outages. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will initially focus on zonal resilience, building automation that helps services safely evacuate and recover from zonal failures, while also contributing to fault injection, incident replay, gameday orchestration, and reliability tooling. You will work across engineering teams to design systems that safely exercise production failure modes and turn findings into verified remediation. You will also help advance the use of AI and automation to identify, test, and close resilience gaps as Datadog’s software and infrastructure evolve.</p> <p>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build zonal-resilience automation that coordinates safe workload evacuations, switchovers, and recovery in partnership with the teams that own affected services.</li> <li>Design and build fault-injection systems for production environments, including infrastructure- and application-level testing, incident replay, and controlled resilience experiments.</li> <li>Develop safeguards such as blast-radius controls, kill switches, validation mechanisms, and rollback paths that keep production experiments contained and reversible.</li> <li>Build agents and automation that help propose failure scenarios, triage experiment results, and connect reliability findings to tracked remediation and verification.</li> <li>Lead gamedays from hypothesis and scenario design through execution, documented findings, remediation tracking, and validation of completed fixes.</li> <li>Design and implement reliable distributed systems, including gRPC services, Kubernetes controllers, and shared platform components, while contributing to technical design and mentoring other engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong distributed systems fundamentals and can reason about consistency, failure modes, backpressure, idempotency, quorum, retries, and failure recovery.</li> <li>You understand Kubernetes workload lifecycles, including how pods, controllers, scheduling, draining, and eviction interact with resilient system design.</li> <li>You have experience designing, building, or operating production systems where safety, availability, and controlled failure handling are important.</li> <li>You communicate complex technical decisions clearly through design documents, runbooks, postmortems, and cross-functional technical discussions.</li> <li>You are comfortable collaborating across engineering teams to understand unfamiliar systems, identify failure modes, and drive resilience improvements.</li> <li>Experience with reliability engineering, chaos engineering, zonal failover, AI-assisted operational workflows, traffic interception, or large-scale observability systems is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <p>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We know not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That’s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>Benefits and Growth:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop deep expertise in distributed systems, production resilience, Kubernetes, and large-scale infrastructure.</li> <li>Work on reliability systems that operate across Datadog’s production environment and influence how engineering teams design for failure.</li> <li>Grow your experience designing safe, automated approaches to fault injection, zonal resilience, and incident reproduction.</li> <li>Explore practical applications of AI and automation to reliability engineering and operational workflows.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, databases, observability, and service teams on complex systems challenges.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical designs, engineering practices, and platform strategy.</li> <li>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</li> </ul> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
description: SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. The Role As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right. You own the code that runs in the factory. What We're Looking For 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable. B-rep and Mesh Depth . You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged. Kernel Fluency . Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes.
  • Technical Excellence. Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. 
  • Manufacturing Instinct. Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors.
  • End-to-End Ownership. Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • Maniacal Urgency. Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it.
  • People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.

raw.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
raw.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.


What you'll do

Architecture

  • Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

  • Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

  • Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

  • Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

  • Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

    • Configuration & tooling

  • Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

  • Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

  • Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure


    • What we're looking for

    Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

  • Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

  • Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

  • High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

  • Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

  • Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

  • Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

  • You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

  • You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

  • You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

  • You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.
